selection_unit: eligible 32-input + 8-target training window; original CSV unchanged
score: mean absolute adjacent difference across 31 input transitions and 15 train-standardized channels

downweight_quiet.loss_weight: 0.25 if score <= train Q25, otherwise 1; divide batch weighted loss by fixed population expected loss weight

random_drop.sampling_weight: 0 for fixed equal-count random mask, otherwise 1

oversample_high.sampling_weight: 2 if score > train Q90, otherwise 1; normalize across candidate pool

month_matched_drop.sampling_weight: 0 for month-stratified random removal matching drop_quiet month counts; otherwise 1

protect_lps_matched.sampling_weight: restore all month_matched_drop exclusions with any raw LPS=1 in the 32 input rows; remove equal-count original non-LPS retained windows per month; 0/1 weights

placebo_matched_swap.sampling_weight: same replacement removals as protect_lps_matched; restore equal-count ordinary excluded windows per month instead of rare LPS windows; 0/1 weights

future_conflict_downweight.sampling_weight: 1 for all; same uniform draw sequence
future_conflict_downweight.loss_weight: 0.25 for negative lowest-quartile source gradient alignment, 1 otherwise; population expectation normalization

future_conflict_shuffled.sampling_weight: 1 for all; same uniform draw sequence
future_conflict_shuffled.loss_weight: month-shuffled control of future_conflict_downweight within scored historical source
